name: 카티야
motion_summary: Eternal Return Katja Precision Aim: silver long ponytail, pale serious teal eyes, NO GLASSES, black/teal sniper outfit and long rifle exactly from reference. R drone scans first, then she fires three progressively stronger precision rounds. Sequence: ready; raise rifle; bend front knee; small drone floats above-right of shoulder and casts compact turquoise scanning reticle to the right; shoulder rifle; first muzzle flash and recoil; re-center; second shot with stronger recoil; brace; third powerful straight teal-white round; lower rifle as drone retreats; ready. Distinct arm and torso recoil, rifle never covers both eyes. No giant portals or unrelated laser cannon. Three shots visually separate. Cell margins generous.
visual_review: 안경 없이 청록 눈과 긴 은발·저격소총이 식별됩니다. 드론 스캔 후 세 사격, 반동과 회수가 분리됩니다.
